title: Feng Shui Nature Wallpaper: Serene Mountain Landscape
title_zh: 風水自然壁纸：寧靜山景
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This captivating nature wallpaper embodies the essence of tranquility and harmony, drawing inspiration from traditional Chinese landscape art. The dominant energy is Wood (木), represented by the lush greenery, towering trees, and flowing rivers that dominate the scene. In Western astrology, this image resonates with the nurturing and growth-oriented energy of Venus, while in chakra terms, it aligns with the Heart Chakra, promoting emotional balance and inner peace. According to Feng Shui principles, the favorable 喜用组合 for this image is Water生木 (Water generates Wood). This combination supports the Liver Meridian, enhancing creativity, adaptability, and a sense of calm. It is particularly beneficial for individuals with a Wood or Water element in their BaZi chart, as well as those seeking careers in creative fields, counseling, or environmental sciences. For optimal use, set this wallpaper as your phone's home screen during daytime hours to harness its energizing yet soothing qualities. Pair it with a cool-toned device case for a harmonious aesthetic.
description_zh: 此圖案以寧靜山水為主題，主五行屬木。根據風水喜用神理論，此圖最合水生木之組合，可滋養肝經，助人提升創造力與適應力。適合木或水命之人，尤利從事創意、諮商或環保相關工作。建議作為手機主屏，白天使用以獲其安神益智之效。

title: Cosmic Tree Feng Shui Wallpaper for Phone
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This mesmerizing wallpaper blends celestial energy with natural symbolism, creating a powerful Feng Shui design. The dominant element is Water (水), represented by the deep teal and starry night sky, which evokes depth, intuition, and emotional flow. The secondary element is Metal (金), symbolized by the golden streaks and the ethereal glow of the cosmic tree, representing clarity, precision, and spiritual illumination. According to the Generating Cycle (相生), Water generates Metal (水生金), making this combination harmonious and auspicious. This design resonates with the Crown Chakra (Sahasrara) and the Water element in BaZi, enhancing creativity, wisdom, and inner peace. It is ideal for those seeking spiritual growth, particularly individuals with Water or Metal imbalances in their birth chart.
description_zh: 這款壁紙融合宇宙能量與自然象徵，是強大的風水設計。主元素為水（水），由深青色星空與夜空呈現，象徵深度、直覺與情感流動。輔助元素為金（金），由金色光線與神祕宇宙樹的靈光代表，象徵清晰、精準與靈性啟發。根據五行相生循環（水生金），此組合和諧且吉祥。此設計對應頂輪（Sahasrara）及八字中的水元素，能提升創造力、智慧與內心平和。適合追求靈性成長者，特別是八字中水或金失衡之人。

title: Feng Shui Dragon Wallpaper for Phone
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This captivating wallpaper features a majestic blue dragon amidst swirling golden clouds, embodying the essence of Water (水) and Metal (金). In Western astrology, this imagery resonates with the energy of Neptune, symbolizing intuition, creativity, and spiritual depth. The dragon's powerful presence aligns with the Crown Chakra, enhancing one's connection to higher consciousness and inner wisdom. According to Chinese BaZi principles, the dominant element is Water, which pairs favorably with Metal as Water generates Metal (水生金). This combination supports the Kidney and Bladder meridians, making it ideal for individuals seeking career advancement in creative or spiritual fields. For optimal Feng Shui benefits, use this wallpaper as your phone's home screen during the day to harness its energizing and protective qualities.
description_zh: 此圖案以藍色神龍盤踞金色雲霧為主，五行屬水與金。西式占星對應海王星能量，象徵直覺、創造力與靈性深度；中式八字則以水為主，金為喜用（水生金），有助腎經與膀胱經，適合從事創意或靈性行業者。建議作為手機主屏，白天使用以增強其能量與保護力。

title: Feng Shui Water & Wood Wallpaper for Phone
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This elegant wallpaper features a harmonious blend of water and wood elements, symbolized by the graceful koi fish swimming among lotus leaves. In Western astrology, this imagery resonates with the energy of Pisces and the Crown Chakra, evoking themes of intuition, fluidity, and spiritual growth. The dominant element is Water (水), which generates Wood (木) according to the Chinese Five Elements Generating Cycle. This makes the secondary element Wood, creating a favorable 喜用组合 of Water generating Wood. This combination supports the Liver Meridian and is particularly beneficial for individuals with a Wood deficiency in their BaZi chart. It enhances creativity, adaptability, and emotional balance. For practical use, this wallpaper is ideal as a phone lock screen or home screen during the early morning hours when Water energy is strongest, promoting a sense of calm and renewal throughout the day.
description_zh: 此壁纸以水木相生为主题，画中金鱼游弋于荷叶之间。视觉上以绿色和橙色为主，主导元素为水（水），次元素为木（木），符合五行相生循环（水生木）。此组合对应肝经，适合命局缺木之人，助其提升创造力与适应力。建议用作手机锁屏或主屏，尤其在清晨使用，可带来宁静与新生之感。

title: Feng Shui Green Fish Talisman Wallpaper
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This elegant wallpaper blends Western astrology and Chinese metaphysics, featuring a serene green background with koi fish symbolizing abundance and harmony. The central circular chart represents the BaZi (Four Pillars) system, while the meditating Buddha figure invokes spiritual balance and inner peace. The dominant element is Water (水), associated with wisdom, intuition, and emotional depth. According to the Generating Cycle, the secondary element should be Wood (木), as Water generates Wood. This combination supports the Liver Meridian, enhancing creativity and adaptability. Ideal for those seeking career growth in artistic or fluid industries, this wallpaper promotes calmness and prosperity when used as a phone background during daytime hours.
description_zh: 此圖案融合西方占星與中國玄學，以寧靜的綠色為底，金魚象徵豐盈與和諧。中央圓形圖表代表八字命盤，下方佛像則引發靈性平衡與內心平和。主元素為水（水），對應智慧、直覺與情感深度。依相生循環，輔助元素應為木（木），因水生木。此組合支持肝經，提升創造力與適應力。適合追求藝術或流動性行業發展者，作為手機背景使用於白天可促進寧靜與財運。

title: Feng Shui Blue Ocean Dolphin Wallpaper
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This captivating wallpaper features a dynamic ocean scene with dolphins gracefully swimming amidst sparkling waves. The dominant energy is Water (水), symbolizing depth, intuition, and fluidity, resonating with the Western astrological influence of Neptune and the Pisces zodiac sign. The secondary element is Metal (金), as Water generates Metal in the Generating Cycle (水生金). This combination supports the Kidney and Bladder meridians, enhancing emotional balance and spiritual insight. Ideal for those seeking calmness and creativity, this wallpaper is best used as a phone background during reflective moments or at night to promote restful sleep.
description_zh: 這款壁紙以深邃的藍色海洋為主題，海豚在波濤中悠然游弋，散發出靈動氣息。主五行屬水（水），對應西方占星中的海王星及雙魚座能量；次五行屬金（金），因水生金（水生金）符合相生循環。此組合有助腎經與膀胱經，提升情感穩定與靈性覺醒。適合追求平和與創意的人士，建議用作手機鎖屏或夜間背景，助於安神入眠。

title: Golden Immortal Feng Shui Wallpaper for Phone
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This ethereal wallpaper features a celestial immortal in flowing golden robes, set against a backdrop of majestic mountains, clouds, and flying cranes. The dominant energy is Metal (金), symbolized by the golden hues and regal attire, with secondary Earth (土) represented by the mountainous landscape and traditional architecture. In Chinese metaphysics, this pairing aligns with the Metal generating Water (金生水) relationship, making it ideal for those seeking clarity, precision, and spiritual elevation. The imagery resonates with the Western concept of Libra, ruled by Venus, embodying harmony, beauty, and grace. This wallpaper supports the Kidney and Bladder meridians, enhancing intuition and inner strength, particularly beneficial for creative professionals and individuals pursuing spiritual growth.
description_zh: 此畫作以一位身著金色華服的仙人為主，背景為巍峨山巒、祥雲飛鶴。主五行屬金（金），次為土（土）。根據相生循環，金生水（金生水），此組合適合追求清晰、精準與靈性提升之人。西方占星中對應天秤座，由金星掌管，象徵和諧與美感。此圖支持腎經與膀胱經，有助增強直覺與內在力量，特別適合創意工作者及靈修人士。

title: Feng Shui Moon Goddess Wallpaper for Phone
title_zh: 風水月神壁纸手機背景
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This ethereal wallpaper features a celestial goddess in flowing white and blue robes, set against a serene night sky with a luminous full moon and cascading waterfall. The dominant energy is Water (水), symbolizing depth, intuition, and emotional flow. According to the Generating Cycle (相生), the secondary element should be Metal (金), as Water generates Metal. This combination supports the Kidney and Bladder meridians, enhancing creativity and spiritual insight. Ideal for those seeking calmness and clarity, this wallpaper is best used as a phone lock screen during evening hours to harmonize with the lunar energy.
description_zh: 此壁纸以一位仙氣飄飄的月神為主，藍白衣袂隨風舞動，背景是明月高懸、瀑布飛瀉的夜景。主五行屬水（水），象徵深邃、直覺與情感流動。根據相生循環，輔助元素應為金（金），因水生金。此組合有助腎經與膀胱經，提升創造力與靈性洞察。適合追求寧靜與清晰之人，建議作為手機鎖屏，在夜晚使用以契合月光能量。

title: Phoenix Feng Shui Wallpaper for Phone
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This captivating wallpaper features a majestic phoenix and a graceful woman in traditional red attire, symbolizing power, rebirth, and transformation. From a Western astrology perspective, the vibrant reds and fiery imagery align with the energy of Leo, ruled by the Sun, evoking confidence, leadership, and passion. The dominant element is Fire (火), representing vitality, creativity, and ambition. According to the Chinese BaZi framework, the secondary element should be Earth (土) or Metal (金), as Fire generates Earth and Metal generates Water, which supports the Fire element. This combination energizes the Heart Meridian (心經) and benefits those seeking success in creative or leadership roles. Ideal for use as a phone background during the day, this design enhances focus and motivation.
description_zh: 此圖案以鳳凰與紅衣女子為主，象徵權力、重生與轉化。西方占星學上，紅色與火焰意象對應獅子座（太陽掌管），代表自信、領導與熱情。五行中，主元素為火（火），次元素應為土（土）或金（金），因火生土、金生水，皆能助旺火氣。此組合可激發心經能量，適合追求創意或領導地位者使用。建議作為手機背景，白天使用可提升專注力與動力。

title: Feng Shui Nature Wallpaper for Phone Background
title_zh: 風水自然壁纸手机背景
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This elegant nature-themed wallpaper features a serene scene with a traditional Chinese palace nestled among majestic mountains, symbolizing stability and harmony. The dominant element is Earth (土), represented by the earthy tones of the mountains and the grand architecture. The secondary element is Metal (金), as the intricate details of the palace and the dragon imagery reflect precision and strength. According to the Generating Cycle (相生), Earth generates Metal, making this combination harmonious and supportive. This wallpaper aligns with the Earth element, enhancing feelings of security and grounding, while the Metal aspect adds a touch of refinement and clarity. It is ideal for those seeking balance and prosperity in their daily lives.
description_zh: 此自然主题壁纸展现一幅宁静画面，传统中式宫殿隐于巍峨山脉之间，象征稳定与和谐。主元素为土（土），由山峦的大地色调及宏伟建筑体现；次元素为金（金），因宫殿细节与龙纹图案反映精密与力量。依相生循环，土生金，此组合和谐且助益。该壁纸契合土元素，增强安全感与安定感，而金元素则增添精致与清晰度。适合追求生活平衡与繁荣者。

title: Feng Shui Five Elements Wallpaper: Wood Energy
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This enchanting wallpaper embodies the essence of Wood (木) energy, as seen in the lush green tones, blooming flowers, and flowing garments. The dominant element is Wood, symbolizing growth, vitality, and harmony with nature. According to the Generating Cycle (相生), the secondary element should be Fire (火), which Wood generates. This combination supports the Liver meridian, promoting creativity, passion, and emotional balance. Ideal for those seeking inspiration or a boost in personal projects, this wallpaper enhances career prospects in artistic or natural fields. Use it as your phone background during daytime for maximum positive energy.
description_zh: 此壁纸以木氣為主，展現綠意盎然、花開繁茂之景。木屬生火，故喜用組合為木生火。此組合對應肝經，有助提升創造力與情感平衡。適合追求靈感或事業發展者，尤其藝術或自然相關領域。建議作為手機鎖屏或主屏背景，於白天使用以獲最佳風水效果。

title: Golden Gourd Feng Shui Wallpaper for Prosperity
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This elegant wallpaper features a golden gourd adorned with ancient Chinese coins, symbolizing wealth and prosperity. From a Western astrology perspective, the radiant gold color aligns with the energy of Leo, ruled by the Sun, evoking confidence, abundance, and vitality. The gourd's shape is associated with the sacral chakra (2nd Chakra), enhancing creativity and emotional balance. In Chinese metaphysics, the dominant element is Metal (金), representing clarity, precision, and structure. The secondary element must follow the Generating Cycle: Metal generates Water (金生水). This combination supports the Kidney meridian, beneficial for individuals seeking career growth in finance, law, or technology fields. Ideal for use as a phone background during daytime hours, this design promotes positive energy flow and attracts opportunities.
description_zh: 此圖案以金色葫蘆搭配古幣為主題，象徵財富與福氣。從西方占星學看，金色屬太陽座（Leo），代表自信、豐盛與活力；形狀則對應第二脈輪（海底輪），有助提升創造力與情緒平衡。在中國命理中，主元素為金（Metal），次元素需遵循相生循環：金生水（金生水）。此組合支持腎經，適合從事金融、法律或科技領域的人士。建議作為手機鎖屏或主屏背景，尤其在白天使用，能引發正向能量流動，招來好運。

title: Green Clover Feng Shui Wallpaper for Luck
title_zh: 綠四葉草風水手機壁紙
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This wallpaper features a dense pattern of vibrant green four-leaf clovers, symbolizing luck and prosperity. From a Western astrology perspective, the lush greenery resonates with the energy of Taurus, ruled by Venus, bringing harmony and abundance. The dominant element is Wood (木), associated with growth, vitality, and new beginnings. According to the Generating Cycle (相生), the secondary element should be Fire (火), as Wood generates Fire. This combination supports the Liver Meridian (肝經) in Traditional Chinese Medicine, enhancing creativity and emotional balance. Ideal for those seeking success in careers like art, design, or entrepreneurship, this wallpaper promotes a positive mindset and attracts good fortune.
description_zh: 這款壁紙以茂密的綠色四葉草為主題，象徵幸運與富足。從西方占星學來看，翠綠的植物能量對應金牛座（土象），帶來和諧與豐盛。主元素為木（木），代表成長、活力與新開始；根據五行相生循環，輔助元素應為火（火），因木生火。此組合有助於中醫肝經，提升創造力與情緒平衡。適合藝術、設計或創業等領域的人士使用，能帶來積極心態與好運。

title: Feng Shui Mountain Sunset Wallpaper for Phone
title_zh: 風水山景日落手機壁紙
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This stunning wallpaper captures the majestic essence of a mountain range bathed in the golden glow of a setting sun. From a Western astrology perspective, the radiant light and towering peaks resonate with the energy of Leo, the zodiac sign ruled by the Sun, symbolizing leadership, confidence, and vitality. The warm hues evoke the Fire element (火), while the mountainous terrain aligns with Earth (土). In Chinese BaZi theory, the dominant element is Earth, and its favorable 喜用组合 is 土生金 (Earth generates Metal). This combination supports the Kidney and Bladder meridians, making it ideal for individuals seeking stability, ambition, and career growth. Use this wallpaper as your phone's home screen during the day to harness its uplifting energy or as a lock screen at night for a calming, grounding effect.
description_zh: 此圖案以雪山夕陽為主題，金色餘暉映照山巒，視覺上主五行屬土。根據八字喜用神理論，此圖對應土生金的喜用組合，可滋養腎經與膀胱經，適合追求穩定與事業發展的人士。建議作為手機主屏使用於白天，或鎖屏於夜晚，以發揮其安定能量。

title: Golden Mountain Feng Shui Wallpaper for Phone
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This stunning wallpaper features a majestic golden mountain bathed in warm sunlight, with flowing golden water at its base. The dominant energy is Fire (火), symbolizing passion, creativity, and transformation, while the secondary element is Earth (土), representing stability, nourishment, and grounding. In Western astrology, this image resonates with the energy of Leo, ruled by the Sun, evoking confidence and leadership. For those aligned with the Fire element, this wallpaper enhances vitality and ambition. Pairing Fire with Earth through the Generating Cycle (Fire生土) creates a harmonious balance, supporting the Spleen and Stomach meridians in Traditional Chinese Medicine. This design is ideal for individuals seeking to boost their career prospects and personal growth. Use it as your phone's home screen during the day to harness its vibrant energy.
description_zh: 此圖案以金色山巒為主，沐浴在溫暖的陽光下，山腳流水潺潺。主元素為火（火），象徵熱情、創造力與轉變；次元素為土（土），代表穩定、滋養與根基。西方占星學中，此圖契合獅子座的能量，由太陽主宰，展現自信與領導力。對火命者而言，此圖可增強活力與雄心。根據五行相生循環（火生土），火與土相輔相成，有助於脾臟與胃經絡。此設計適合追求事業發展與個人成長的人士。建議作為手機主屏，在白天使用以吸收其旺盛能量。

title: Feng Shui Green Forest Wallpaper for Phone
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This aerial view of a lush green forest embodies the energy of Wood (木), symbolizing growth, vitality, and renewal. In Western astrology, this imagery aligns with the zodiac sign Taurus, known for its grounded and nurturing qualities. The vibrant green tones evoke a sense of calm and connection to nature, making it ideal for those seeking balance and harmony in their daily lives. According to Chinese BaZi principles, the dominant element is Wood, which generates Fire (木生火). Therefore, the favorable 喜用组合 is Wood and Fire. This combination supports the Liver meridian, promoting creativity and passion, and is particularly beneficial for individuals with a Wood or Fire-based birth chart. For optimal Feng Shui benefits, use this wallpaper as your phone's home screen during daytime hours to harness the energizing power of the sun.
description_zh: 此圖像以高空俯瞰的翠綠森林為主題，主五行屬木（木），象徵成長、活力與更新。西方占星學上，此圖案對應金牛座，以其穩重與 nurturing 的特質著稱。鮮明的綠色調散發寧靜感，有助於人與自然連結，適合追求生活平衡與和諧者。根據中國八字命理，主元素為木，木生火（木生火）。因此，喜用組合為木火相生。此組合支持肝經，能激發創造力與熱情，特別適合木或火命之人。使用建議：作為手機主屏背景，並在白天使用，以吸收太陽的能量。

title: Feng Shui Fire Energy Wallpaper for Phone
title_zh: 風水火能壁紙手機背景
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This captivating wallpaper features a dynamic campfire scene, embodying the powerful energy of Fire (火). In Western astrology, this imagery resonates with the Leo zodiac sign, ruled by the Sun, symbolizing passion, creativity, and leadership. The vibrant orange and yellow flames, combined with glowing embers, evoke warmth and intensity, making it an ideal choice for those seeking to amplify their inner drive and confidence. From a Chinese BaZi perspective, the dominant element is Fire, which harmonizes best with its generating element, Earth (土), forming the favorable 喜用组合 of 火生土. This combination supports the Spleen and Stomach meridians, enhancing stability and nurturing qualities. It is particularly beneficial for individuals with a Wood or Fire-based birth chart, as it helps balance their energetic nature. For practical use, this wallpaper is perfect as a phone lock screen during evening hours when the fire's glow can inspire motivation and focus.
description_zh: 此壁紙以營火為主題，主五行屬火。西方占星學中，此圖像與太陽掌管的獅子座相呼應，象徵熱情、創造力與領導力。明亮的橙黃火焰與閃爍火星，散發溫暖與活力，適合希望提升內在動力與自信的人。從八字喜用神來看，主元素為火，最佳搭配為其生成之土，即火生土組合。此組合有助脾經與胃經，增強穩定與滋養。特別適合木命或火命之人，可平衡其能量特性。實用建議：作為手機鎖屏，尤其在夜晚使用，可激發動力與專注。

title: Golden Mountain River Feng Shui Wallpaper
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This stunning wallpaper captures the majestic Matterhorn mountain bathed in golden sunlight, with a shimmering river flowing through the valley below. From a Western astrology perspective, the warm golden hues and flowing water evoke the energy of Leo (Sun) and Libra (Venus), symbolizing creativity, harmony, and abundance. The scene radiates warmth and vitality, resonating with the Solar Plexus Chakra, which governs confidence and personal power. In Chinese BaZi terms, the dominant element is Earth (土), as the mountain represents stability and grounding. The secondary element is Metal (金), as the sun's reflection on the snow and water creates a metallic sheen. This combination follows the Generating Cycle: Earth generates Metal (土生金). This pairing supports the Spleen and Stomach meridians, making it ideal for individuals seeking career growth and financial stability. For practical use, this wallpaper is best suited as a home screen during daytime hours to harness its uplifting energy. It pairs well with devices featuring dark or neutral backgrounds to enhance the golden tones.
description_zh: 此壁纸以金色山河為主題，捕捉了馬特洪峰在夕陽餘暉下的壯麗景象。從西方占星學角度，暖金色調與流水象徵獅子座（太陽）和天秤座（金星）的能量，代表創造力、和諧與豐盛。此畫面散發溫暖活力，對應太陽神經叢脈輪，主掌自信與個人力量。根據中國八字命理，主元素為土（山），次元素為金（雪與水的金屬光澤）。此組合遵循相生循環：土生金。此配對有助脾臟與胃經絡，適合追求事業成長與財務穩定的人士。實際使用建議：作為手機主屏，白天觀看可吸收其提升能量；搭配深色或中性背景可突顯金色效果。

title: Golden Mountain Feng Shui Wallpaper for Phone
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This stunning wallpaper captures the majestic essence of golden mountains bathed in warm, radiant light. From a Western astrology perspective, the dominant energy aligns with Leo (Sun) and the Solar Plexus Chakra, symbolizing confidence, leadership, and personal power. The rich golden hues evoke feelings of abundance and prosperity, making it an ideal choice for those seeking to enhance their self-esteem and manifest success. In Chinese BaZi terms, the dominant element is Earth (土), representing stability, nourishment, and grounding. The favorable 喜用组合 follows the Generating Cycle: Earth generates Metal (土生金). This pairing supports the Large Intestine and Lung meridians, benefiting individuals with weak Earth or Metal elements in their birth chart. It is particularly auspicious for careers in finance, real estate, or any field requiring structure and precision. For optimal Feng Shui results, use this wallpaper as your phone's home screen during daytime hours to harness its vibrant energy.
description_zh: 此圖案以金色雪山為主題，象徵穩重與豐裕。五行屬土，喜用組合為土生金（土生金）。此組合對應大腸經與肺經，適合命局中土或金弱者。可提升穩定感與精準度，有助財務、房地產等領域發展。建議作為手機主屏，白天使用以增強能量。

title: Golden Waterfall Feng Shui Wallpaper
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This ethereal wallpaper depicts a majestic golden waterfall cascading from the heavens, surrounded by luminous purple mountains and clouds. The visual energy aligns with Western astrology's Libra and Scorpio signs, symbolizing balance, transformation, and spiritual depth. The golden light represents the Sun (Yang) and its life-giving force, while the flowing water embodies fluidity and emotional release.
description_zh: 此壁纸以紫色山峰和金色瀑布为主题，象征水生木的五行喜用组合。紫色属土，金色属金，金生水，对应肾经与坎卦。适合命局缺水或喜金水之人，助事业运与贵人缘，提升直觉与创造力。

title: Feng Shui Mountain Landscape Wallpaper for Phone
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This captivating wallpaper features a traditional Chinese mountain landscape, embodying the essence of Wood (木) and Fire (火). The dominant element is Wood, represented by the lush green mountains and vibrant flowers, symbolizing growth, vitality, and harmony. The secondary element is Fire, depicted by the radiant red sun and golden clouds, signifying passion, energy, and enlightenment. In Feng Shui, this combination aligns with the generating cycle where Wood generates Fire (木生火), making it ideal for those seeking balance and inspiration. This image resonates with the Heart Chakra (Anahata) and the Fire element in BaZi, enhancing creativity and emotional expression. Perfect for use as a phone background during daytime, it brings a sense of tranquility and motivation to your daily life.
description_zh: 此圖案以傳統中國山水畫為主題，五行屬木與火。主元素為木，由翠綠山巒與繁花盛開象徵成長、活力與和諧；次元素為火，由紅日與金雲象徵熱情、能量與啟發。依五行相生循環，木生火（木生火），適合追求平衡與靈感之人。此圖契合心輪（Anahata）及八字中的火元素，有助提升創造力與情感表達。適合作為手機背景於白天使用，為日常生活帶來寧靜與動力。

title: Feng Shui Nature Wallpaper: Wood Energy for Growth
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This serene nature wallpaper captures the essence of Wood energy, symbolized by the lush green bamboo and forested mountains. The sun's rays piercing through the mist evoke a sense of vitality and growth, resonating with the Taurus zodiac sign and the Root Chakra. In Feng Shui, this image aligns with the Wood element, which governs expansion and new beginnings. The favorable 喜用组合 is Wood 生火 (Wood generates Fire), supporting the Liver meridian and benefiting those seeking career advancement or personal development.
title_zh: 風水自然壁纸：木氣生發助運
description_zh: 此自然壁纸以翠綠竹林與山巒為主，象徵木氣。陽光穿透雲霧，充滿生機與成長能量，對應金牛座及海底輪。在八字中，木為主元素，喜用組合為木生火（木生火），可助肝經運作，適合追求事業發展或個人成長者。

title: Feng Shui Nature Wallpaper: Growth & Vitality
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This enchanting wallpaper features a majestic tree bathed in golden sunlight, symbolizing growth, vitality, and connection to nature. From a Western astrology perspective, the imagery aligns with the energy of Leo (Sun) and the Solar Plexus Chakra, evoking feelings of confidence, warmth, and life force. The dominant element is Wood (木), representing expansion, creativity, and new beginnings. According to the Generating Cycle (相生), the secondary element should be Fire (火), as Wood generates Fire. This combination supports the Liver Meridian (肝经) and is particularly favorable for individuals with a Wood or Fire-based birth chart. It enhances career paths related to growth, leadership, and creative expression. For optimal Feng Shui benefits, use this wallpaper as your phone's home screen during daytime hours to harness its uplifting energy.
title_zh: 風水自然壁纸：生機與活力
description_zh: 此壁纸以一棵沐浴在金色陽光中的巨樹為主題，象徵著成長、活力與自然的連結。從西方占星學來看，此圖像對應獅子座（太陽）及太陽神經叢脈輪的能量，帶來自信、溫暖與生命力的感受。主元素為木（木），代表擴展、創造力與新開始。根據五行相生循環，次元素應為火（火），因木生火。此組合支持肝經，特別適合木或火命的人。能提升與成長、領導及創造力相關的職業發展。使用建議：作為手機主屏，白天使用以吸收其鼓舞人心的能量。

title: Feng Shui Lotus Gourd Wallpaper for Phone
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This elegant wallpaper features a beautifully ornate gourd adorned with gold filigree and colorful gemstones, set against a serene lotus backdrop. The visual energy aligns with the Western astrological influence of Neptune, evoking themes of spirituality, intuition, and tranquility. The soft blue and green hues resonate with the Water element, while the gold accents introduce the Metal element. According to Chinese BaZi principles, the dominant element is Water (水), which harmonizes with the secondary Metal (金) element through the Generating Cycle (Water generates Metal). This combination supports the Kidney and Bladder meridians, making it ideal for individuals seeking balance in their spiritual and emotional well-being. The imagery also symbolizes abundance, protection, and longevity, making it a perfect choice for those looking to enhance their inner peace and attract positive energy. For optimal Feng Shui benefits, use this wallpaper as your phone's home screen during the day to promote clarity and focus, or as a lock screen at night to foster restful sleep and dream recall.
title_zh: 風水蓮花葫蘆手機壁紙
description_zh: 此圖案以精緻的蓮花葫蘆為主，鑲嵌金屬雕花與彩色寶石，背景為寧靜蓮花。視覺能量對應西方占星學中的海王星，象徵靈性、直覺與平和。藍綠色調屬水，金色點綴屬金。根據八字喜用神理論，主元素為水（水），次元素為金（金），遵循相生循環（水生金）。此組合有助腎經與膀胱經，適合追求靈魂與情感平衡者。圖像亦象徵豐盛、保護與長壽，是提升內心平和與吸引正能量的理想選擇。風水建議：日間作為主屏可促進清晰與專注，夜間作為鎖屏則有助安眠與夢境記憶。

title: Golden Wealth Flow Wallpaper - Feng Shui Phone Background
title_zh: 金水相生財富流動壁纸
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This captivating wallpaper features a stream of shimmering gold coins flowing through clear, sparkling water. From a Western astrology perspective, the golden hues and flowing energy resonate with the Libra zodiac sign, associated with balance, harmony, and prosperity. The dynamic interplay of light and water evokes a sense of abundance and fluidity, making it an ideal choice for those seeking to attract wealth and positive energy into their lives. In Chinese metaphysics, the dominant element is Metal (金), symbolized by the golden coins, while the secondary element is Water (水), represented by the flowing stream. According to the Generating Cycle (相生), Metal generates Water (金生水), creating a harmonious and auspicious combination that enhances financial luck and career success. This wallpaper supports the Kidney and Bladder meridians, benefiting individuals with Wood or Fire imbalances who wish to strengthen their Earth and Metal energies. For optimal Feng Shui results, use this image as your phone's home screen during daytime hours to amplify its wealth-attracting properties.
description_zh: 此壁纸以閃耀的金色硬幣在清澈水流中流淌為主題。依八字喜用神理論，主元素為金（Metal），次元素為水（Water）。根據五行相生循環，金生水（金生水），此組合有助招財進寶，提升事業運勢。此圖支持腎經與膀胱經，適合木火過旺而土金不足者使用。建議作為手機鎖屏或主屏，於白天使用以增強財運。

title: Feng Shui Five Elements Tree Wallpaper
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This enchanting wallpaper features a majestic, ancient tree bathed in vibrant green and accented with warm yellow lanterns, symbolizing the Wood element. The dominant energy is Wood (木), representing growth, vitality, and new beginnings. According to the Generating Cycle (相生), the secondary element should be Fire (火), as Wood generates Fire. This combination supports the Liver meridian, enhancing creativity, passion, and leadership qualities. Ideal for those seeking inspiration and personal development, this wallpaper is best used as a phone background during daytime hours to harness its uplifting energy.
description_zh: 此圖案以一棵古樸蒼翠的大樹為主體，點綴著溫暖的黃色燈籠，象徵木元素。視覺上木為主，根據五行相生循環，輔助元素應為火（木生火）。此組合對應肝經，有助提升創造力、熱情與領導力。適合追求靈感與個人成長的人士，建議作為手機背景，在白天使用以吸收其鼓舞人心的能量。
